section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the concept of positive body image, defining it as love, respect, and acceptance of one's body, and highlights its core features. It discusses the independence of positive and negative body image and reviews existing literature on the positive association between body image and various indicators of hedonic well-being (e.g., optimism, self-esteem). The section also identifies two limitations in current understanding: the focus on singular facets of positive body image (primarily body appreciation) and the neglect of eudaimonic well-being facets (psychological and social well-being). No specific studies are presented in this section.
